description: Two-phase chat workflow: refine and enrich the user's raw message into a clear "official input" before doing heavy work. Activate with CONTRIBUT ON or phrases like "modo Contribut", "Contribut", "refinar mi input antes de responder". Deactivate with CONTRIBUT OFF. One-shot bypass: CONTRIBUT SKIP. Gate to full reply: user sends ACEPTO BORRADOR (optionally pasting the refined text). Use when the user wants higher input precision and alignment before execution.
